subject.title: Overview Event Log and Gateway Log panels do not stay aligned when their content heights differ

question: Should this issue be transferred to `openclaw/openclaw` for current-main reproduction and ownership?
rationale: ClawHub cannot implement the requested change, while only a maintainer can transfer the report or deliberately retain it here pending new evidence.

options.title: Transfer and re-verify
options.body: Move the report to OpenClaw and attach a current browser reproduction before implementing any remaining layout change.

options.title: Request fresh proof here
options.body: Keep it in ClawHub temporarily and ask for a current screenshot, viewport dimensions, and unequal panel-content state.

recommendation.title: Transfer and re-verify
recommendation.body: Move the report to OpenClaw and attach a current browser reproduction before implementing any remaining layout change.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current component structure containing both affected panels.
